A '''mandolin''' was a stringed [[Music/Legends|musical instrument]].

{{Music-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
An illustration from ''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]'' shows a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] at a party playing what looks like a real-world [[Wikipedia:mandolin|mandolin]]. A mandolin briefly appeared in a vision in [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] by [[Barbara Hambly]].
